say:1:1360243001:1.text: Impressive! To create a festival endorsed by a Celestial is really something.
say:1:1360243001:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，虽然梅林这家伙干什么都很正常，但直接创造一个有...

say:2:1360243002:1.text: But surely they should give me some credit for this festival, right?
say:2:1360243002:1.source_cn: 只不过，这次的节日至少有一多半的功劳应该归我吧？！

say:3:1360243003:1.text: That's the right thing to do! I should have naming rights too! Why not call it the Berial Revelry?
say:3:1360243003:1.source_cn: 对吧对吧，明明应该是我！我也应该有冠名权！这个节日有一...

say:4:1360243004:1.text: Ugh, forget it. Even I find it cringy.

say:5:1360243005:1.text: As forgiving as I am, I won't hold it against them.
say:5:1360243005:1.source_cn: 算了，宽宏大量的我就这样面对人类的不公平吧，

say:6:1360243006:1.text: No matter what, I've done my very best...
say:6:1360243006:1.source_cn: 不过嘛，无论如何，我也算是尽心尽力了……

say:7:1360243007:1.text: The music humans enjoy must sound like unbearable clamor to your ears, right?
say:7:1360243007:1.source_cn: 在诸位的耳中，人类认为美妙的东西多半犹如嘈杂刺耳的噪音...

say:8:1360243008:1.text: Would you be able to appreciate the beauty within the noise?
say:8:1360243008:1.source_cn: 但是反过来说，如果真的是噪音，诸位能否欣赏呢？

say:9:1360243009:1.text: Hahaha! Just let me do a little something for you while you continue your slumber!
say:9:1360243009:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈，就当成我在诸位做着深沉美梦时的一点小小...

say:10:1360243010:1.text: Unlike you all, I'm extremely polite and humane!
say:10:1360243010:1.source_cn: 与你们不同，我可是非——常非常有礼貌，非常人性化的人！

say:11:1360243011:1.text: Please bear with me, whether you're awakened, annoyed, or grateful to my music...
say:11:1360243011:1.source_cn: 那么，无论有没有被吵醒，是恨得牙痒痒，还是对我的关怀感...

say:12:1360243012:1.source_cn: 都享受这片刻的时光吧！
